caption: The drawing features a horizontal decorative border set against a plain, off-white background. The border consists of a deep brown band edged with green lines on the top and bottom. Within this band, on the left side, there is a gold oval medallion flanked by symmetrical, stylized gold leaves. To the right of the medallion, there is a grouping of two large pink roses, accompanied by smaller pink flowers and a collection of green and gold leaves. Above the flowers and medallion, there are patterns of pink dots and swirls arranged in a decorative manner. The drawing is rendered in a mix of soft and bold colors, with gold, green, brown, pink, and white making up the primary color palette. The elements are set against the dark brown background of the border, which contrasts with the plain surrounding space.
title: Wall Paper Border
